correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives commuting affine polynomials in the row-regular interaction matrix; telescoping on a synchronous periodic orbit yields the exact monodromy polynomial, and spectral mapping gives all Floquet multipliers. Boundary corollaries were checked separately.

originality.rationale: Planar symmetric Ricker cycles, general Jacobian-product stability, and generic master-stability eigenmode decompositions are prior art. The claim is restricted to the exact row-regular competition-matrix Floquet polynomial and its closed-left-half-plane obstruction, which were not located in the inspected sources.

value.rationale: The reduction replaces an arbitrary-dimensional period-p Floquet product by evaluation of one explicit scalar polynomial on the interaction spectrum, giving reusable stability tests and period-independent instability obstructions.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
